title: Total-complex comparison for normalized native ringed tensors
statement: Given the underived normalized comparison U and a specified scalar sign on ringed morphisms that is the normalized Koszul scalar action, there is a record containing the total-complex isomorphism from b.native applied to T's total to the ringed coefficient total with the reversed factors, its signed homogeneous summand equation, and its naturality under arbitrary maps of complexes.

source.place: Native tensor model, geometric tensor part of steps 1 and 3; Stacks 06YS, 06YU, 0FPT

proof.text: Obtain the natural bifunctor isomorphism whose components are U.underived.
Apply the homological-complex bifunctor comparison and the total-complex flip isomorphism to construct the chain isomorphism.
Use the signed summand and bifunctor naturality laws for this comparison, then package the chain, summand and naturality fields.

statement_change.what: The former statement allowed an arbitrary endomorphism assignment as sign. That is false because such an assignment need not preserve an isomorphism; the corrected statement requires sign p q f to be the normalized integer scalar (-1)^(pq) • f.
